operation.description: Construct canonical rational coordinate functions, their inverse chart, the finite affine-denominator locus, and the exceptional source point from a smooth rational affine conic with a supplied rational point.

examples.description: Parametrize x^2 + x*y - y^2 - 1 = 0 from (1,0); the polynomial must have smooth projective closure and the checked point must lie on it.
examples.name: smooth_conic_from_point

RationalFunction.description:
One reduced element of ``QQ(t_1, ..., t_n)``.

The denominator is monic and the numerator and denominator are coprime.
This makes the sparse representation unique for the declared variable
order.  With no variables, the value is a canonical rational represented
by one constant numerator over the constant denominator one.

output_schema.description: A source-bound affine chart of a smooth projective rational conic.

coordinates.description: Canonical coordinate functions in source-variable order. For every finite parameter outside finite_parameter_denominator=0 they give an affine point on the source conic.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

exceptional_point.description: The supplied source point, omitted by the finite affine parameter chart and attained at projective parameter infinity.

finite_parameter_denominator.description: The monic quadratic whose finite zeros map to points of the projective closure outside the source affine chart.

inverse_parameter.description: The inverse rational parameter in the two source variables. Its denominator-nonzero chart is the conic minus exceptional_point.
